note: Upper bounds in milliseconds for tests/latency-browser-check.js, set 2026-09-26 just above the worst of three Firefox runs on the creator's PC (Chromium is faster everywhere). Creator decision: limits sit at today's real times, not generous ones; any real slowdown must fail. *WorkMs is how long the game's own handlers ran for that input, which only our code affects; the matching *Ms is input to the first task after the next frame, which also includes up to one 60 Hz frame (16.7 ms) of waiting, so a click must show within two frames (34 ms). Known waste, next to cut: new game (26-28 ms of work in Firefox, 8 in Chromium), switching board size (20-21), and the freeze after a game ends (82-91). Tighten when the code gets faster; loosen only by recorded creator decision.
